arguments.command:
cd /app && SCAMP_CORE= python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, os, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submit')
req = json.load(open('/app/tmp/fail.json'))
line = json.dumps(req)+'\n'
# run via the launcher (uses the C core)
p = subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=line, text=True, capture_output=True)
r = json.loads(p.stdout)
print("with C core:", r.get('status'), r.get('cuts'), r.get('used_bits'))
# now force python fallback
env = dict(os.environ); env.pop('SCAMP_CORE', None)
p2 = subprocess.run(['python3','/app/submit/main.py'], input=line, text=True, capture_output=True, env=env)
r2 = json.loads(p2.stdout)
print("python only:", r2.get('status'), r2.get('cuts'), r2.get('used_bits'))
EOF
